name: db-context-engineering-dev
description: Local-dev variant. Loaded via `claude --plugin-dir`; MCP server runs from the working tree via `uv run`.

ctxset.headersHelper: bash -c 'for d in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" "$HOME/.claude/plugins/cache"/*/db-context-engineering*/*; do [ -f "$d/scripts/adc_headers.sh" ] && exec bash "$d/scripts/adc_headers.sh"; done; t="$(gcloud auth application-default print-access-token 2>/dev/null)" || exit 1; f="$GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS"; [ -z "$f" ] && [ -n "$CLOUDSDK_CONFIG" ] && f="$CLOUDSDK_CONFIG/application_default_credentials.json"; [ -z "$f" ] && f="$HOME/.config/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json"; q=""; [ -f "$f" ] && q="$(sed -n "s/.*\"quota_project_id\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p" "$f" | head -n 1)"; [ -z "$q" ] && [ -f "$f" ] && q="$(sed -n "s/.*\"project_id\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p" "$f" | head -n 1)"; [ -z "$q" ] && q="$GOOGLE_CLOUD_QUOTA_PROJECT"; [ -z "$q" ] && q="$GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"; if [ -n "$q" ]; then printf "{\"Authorization\":\"Bearer %s\",\"X-Goog-User-Project\":\"%s\"}" "$t" "$q"; else printf "{\"Authorization\":\"Bearer %s\"}" "$t"; fi'
